overview: Namibia is a country on the Atlantic coast of southern Africa. Its capital and largest city is Windhoek. Namibia was a German colony and was later run by South Africa, before becoming independent in 1990. It is one of the most thinly populated countries in the world, and English is the official language.

geography.text: The Namib Desert, one of the oldest deserts in the world, runs along the whole coast and has some of the tallest sand dunes on Earth, around Sossusvlei. Inland is a central plateau, and the Kalahari Desert lies in the east. Etosha Pan, a vast salt flat in the north, is surrounded by a famous wildlife park.

history.text: San, Nama and Herero peoples lived in the region for a long time. Germany colonised it in 1884, and between 1904 and 1908 German forces killed tens of thousands of Herero and Nama people in what is recognised as a genocide. South Africa took control after the First World War and imposed apartheid. Namibia became independent in 1990.

events.title: Herero and Nama genocide
events.text: German troops kill tens of thousands.

government.text: Namibia is a presidential republic and a stable democracy. SWAPO, which led the independence struggle, has governed since 1990. In 2025 Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah became Namibia's first female President.

economy.text: Mining is the heart of Namibia's economy: it is one of the world's biggest producers of uranium and of gem diamonds, mostly mined from the seabed. Fishing, beef and tourism are also important.

culture.text: Namibia is one of the least densely populated countries in the world. The Namib is the oldest desert on Earth, with towering red dunes. The Himba people are known for covering their skin and hair with red ochre. Namibia was the first country to put protection of the environment into its constitution.

items.title: Sossusvlei
items.text: Red sand dunes over 300 metres high.

items.title: Etosha
items.text: A national park around a huge salt pan.

sport.text: Football and rugby are popular. Frankie Fredericks won four Olympic silver medals in sprinting. Christine Mboma won 200 m silver at the 2021 Olympics.

items.title: Rugby
items.text: Namibia has played at every Rugby World Cup since 1999.
